description: This file defines a base class 'Barcode' and several subclasses for different barcode types (e.g., I2of5, MSI, Codabar, Code11). It includes methods for validation, encoding, decomposition, size computation, and drawing of barcode symbols, utilizing the reportlab library for PDF rendering.

classes.name: Barcode
classes.description: Abstract base class for barcode types, providing common methods for validation, encoding, size calculation, and drawing.

classes.name: MultiWidthBarcode
classes.description: Base class for variable-width barcode types like Code93 and Code128, extending Barcode.

classes.name: I2of5
classes.description: Class representing the Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode, a numeric-only barcode encoding even number of digits.

classes.name: MSI
classes.description: Class for MSI barcode, a numeric-only barcode with optional checksum.

classes.name: Codabar
classes.description: Class for Codabar barcode, supporting start/stop characters and punctuation.

classes.name: Code11
classes.description: Class for Code 11 barcode, encoding digits and dash with optional checksums.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for each barcode class, initializing parameters and calling the base class constructor.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value for barcode encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the validated input into barcode pattern.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Decomposes the encoded string into a pattern suitable for drawing.

methods.name: computeSize
methods.description: Calculates the size (width and height) of the barcode for rendering.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the barcode pattern onto the canvas.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Helper method to draw rectangles representing barcode bars.
